findings.summary: surefire:test --offline needs target/test-classes present; build-reactor -DskipTests install compiles test-classes (test-compile phase runs; only execution skipped). Must pack target/ in artifact and restore it.

Original integration/behavioral profiles used 'mvn test' (surefire), not failsafe. Switching to failsafe would change which plugin executes — a behavior change. Decision: use 'mvn surefire:test -P<profile>' for ALL four maven test jobs to preserve plugin behavior exactly.

Adding 'if: always()' upload-artifact steps to reparented critical-chain jobs makes the estimator parser drop the whole job (line-156 regex), yielding a vacuous budget pass. Do NOT add such steps to contract/integration/behavioral on the critical chain; leave unit-tests' pre-existing upload unchanged.

New step-estimate key 'mvn surefire:test' is a longer match than 'mvn test' so estimator longest-match-wins selects it correctly; no accidental substring collision. contract-verify's 'mvn test -Dtest=...' still maps to mvn test=8 (off critical chain, fine).

resolutionNotes.RT-01: build-reactor now packs target-reactor.tar (all module target/ incl test-classes); setup-java-maven restores it. -DskipTests runs test-compile.
resolutionNotes.RT-02: All four maven test jobs use mvn surefire:test -P<profile> (not failsafe) — original plugin behavior preserved.
resolutionNotes.RT-03: No if:always() upload steps added to reparented critical-chain jobs; unit-tests pre-existing upload unchanged. Estimator shows real serial chain (classify->build-reactor->contract = 14.7).
resolutionNotes.RT-04: mvn surefire:test is a longer/distinct estimate key from mvn test; longest-match-wins selects it. contract-verify mvn test -Dtest=... unaffected (off critical chain).
resolutionNotes.RT-05-security-parallel: build-reactor needs:[classify-changes] only; gate keeps needs:[security-early-fail,...]; security still HARD-blocks via ci-required. Tradeoff: wasted compile on security-failing PR.
